author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
When Adam recently built the blade for his Crouching Tiger sword replica, his sharpening of its edge was only to make it look sharp as a prop. So for today's build, he brings back out the TSPROF knife sharpener kit to actually demonstrate how to use it to actually sharpen a cutting edge of a wood chisel. But what starts off as a sharpening demo turns into a quick build. Enjoy the shop sounds in this one!

Adam Savage Sharpens His Crouching Tiger Sword Blade!: https://youtu.be/K7BanzKNuk0
